title: DoorDash Delivers With the ‘Summer of DashPass’
summary: DashPass members can get massive savings during the 2026 FIFA World Cup this summer.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Calling all soccer fans! With 2026 FIFA World Cup  in full swing, fans from all around the world are flocking to cities in the United States, Canada and Mexico to cheer for their favorite teams and to watch matches together in celebration of all things soccer. Throughout the international tournament, DoorDash is an Official Tournament Sponsor, offering massive savings to make your World Cup watch-parties memorable and fun with the ordering and delivery company’s “ Summer of DashPass ” campaign.

What is DashPass ? It’s DoorDash’s subscription service that features additional perks for members, like reduced delivery and service fees, exclusive deals for restaurants, retailers, grocers and more, earn 5% DoorDash credits on eligible pickup orders, up to 10% off rides from Lyft, and other benefits. DashPass is a way to save big on deliveries and services.
